args.title: Fix password reset email linking to localhost in production
args.body:
File: src/notifications/templates.ts

BASE_URL falls back to "http://localhost:3000" whenever process.env.PUBLIC_URL is unset, and passwordResetEmail (along with rollupText and scheduledExportEmail) builds its links from this BASE_URL. If PUBLIC_URL isn't configured in the production environment, reset links point at localhost instead of the real site, which matches the reported bug.

Proposed fix: ensure PUBLIC_URL is set to the correct production URL in the deployment/environment configuration, and consider making BASE_URL fail loudly (e.g. throw at startup) when PUBLIC_URL is missing in production rather than silently defaulting to localhost, so this class of misconfiguration is caught immediately instead of surfacing in user-facing emails.
